title: pepkio-bio-safe-palette-tester v0.1.0 – a Python client for scientific color palette accessibility testing via the Pepkio life-science calculator suite
description: Permanent archiving of **pepkio-bio-safe-palette-tester** on Zenodo (DOI: 10.5281/zenodo.24146459) supplies a citable, version-pinned Python client for evaluating scientific color palette accessibility, psychophysically modeled color vision deficiency (CVD) simulations, and CIEDE2000 perceptual contrast validation in data visualization workflows. The archived package preserves v0.1.0 to guarantee reproducible figure validation and automated contrast checking across bioinformatics pipelines, delegating perceptual colorimetry and simulation algorithms to the hosted Pepkio calculator API without bundling heavy graphics dependencies. Source code and the issue tracker are maintained at https://github.com/pepkio/pepkio-bio-safe-palette-tester. The primary interactive platform for the same calculations is the [Pepkio Bio-Safe Palette Tester](https://www.pepkio.com/tools/bio-safe-palette-tester), part of a Pepkio suite of more than thirty web tools covering solution prep, PCR, cell culture, assays, pharmacology, education, and sequence utilities. The Python client enables automated accessibility gating and batch palette checks in Jupyter, Nextflow, and Snakemake pipelines. Released under the MIT License; Pepkio (https://www.pepkio.com/) develops laboratory calculators and analysis services (https://www.pepkio.com/cro) for life science research.
notes:
**Suggested citation.** When referencing the archived client in a publication, cite the Zenodo DOI (10.5281/zenodo.24146459) together with the GitHub repository (https://github.com/pepkio/pepkio-bio-safe-palette-tester) and record the client version (v0.1.0) in methods or supplementary materials.

**Programmatic access.** This client is the recommended interface for scripted calls to the Pepkio Bio-Safe Palette Tester API; the interactive web application remains available for manual palette design and exploration. Calculator logic resides on Pepkio servers; this package transmits parameters and returns structured results only.
